domainFactCheckDetails: Indian Independence Act 1947 (10 & 11 Geo. 6 c. 30). Partition casualties estimated by historical consensus at 200,000 to 1,000,000 deaths (range preserved). Displacement: 10–12 million refugees. Princely States: 565 states integrated via Instrument of Accession under Sardar Patel / VP Menon. Jammu & Kashmir Accession: Signed by Maharaja Hari Singh on October 26, 1947; accepted by Lord Mountbatten on October 27, 1947.
